title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Trio #04 (MoroccanZellige+ItalianDeruta+CzechBohemian+PortugueseAzulejo / PeruvianNazca+VietnameseSonMai+IslamicGeometric+JapaneseKutani / IndianMughal+EscherTessellation+CroatianHvar+ChineseCizhou)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a bright cheeky grin, demure and soft, bright golden-blonde hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes. Long square nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs) dominates one zone. Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands, dense repeating floral border) dominates the second zone. Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework, wide silver bands, dense engraved floral facets) dominates the third zone. Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands, dense repeating panel scrollwork) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto slingbacks, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Egyptian woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, cool and composed, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands, dense stepped geometric borders) dominates one zone. Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, wide gold-leaf bands, dense eggshell-white scrollwork) dominates the second zone. Islamic geometric star-tile pattern (a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, wide gold bands, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile) dominates the third zone. Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels, wide gold-and-red bands, dense overglaze florals) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, cheerful, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in braided, real living eyes. Long round nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions, wide gold-and-crimson bands, dense jewel-toned scrollwork) dominates one zone. Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat, wide gold bands, dense morphing tessellation) dominates the second zone. Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework, wide gold bands, dense fine filigree linework) dominates the third zone. Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands, dense leaf scrolls) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform high-heel mules, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
